ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

SortBy.helper: Choose the sort by from the available options.

Title.helper: Enter the title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Description.helper: Enter the formatted content for description. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

Category.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control category.

Homepage.helper: Enter the web address for homepage. You can use a page on this site or another website.

Download.helper: Enter the web address for download. You can use a page on this site or another website.

Symbols.helper: Enter the web address for symbols. You can use a page on this site or another website.

Documentation.helper: Enter the web address for documentation. You can use a page on this site or another website.

Logo.helper: Enter the logo to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

BadgeText.helper: Enter the badge text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Extensions.helper: Add and arrange the items used for extensions. Remove any item you do not need.
